name: devly
description: Devly — A home for curious developers. Learn something new. Build it. Run it. Understand it.

scripts.build:packages: npx tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p packages/mascot/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p packages/execution/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p packages/agents/tsconfig.json
scripts.try-live:smoke: npx tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p packages/execution/tsconfig.json && node scripts/try-live-smoke.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && cd apps/extension && npx vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../devly.vsix
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist apps/webview/dist apps/extension/dist apps/extension/media apps/extension/content
